paragraphs: I'm a Fullstack Developer with experience building complete web applications with modern technologies from the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem. I specialize in building reactive user interfaces and robust APIs.

My core stack includes React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and databases such as MongoDB and PostgreSQL. I also have experience with Docker, AWS and CI/CD practices for automated deployments.
I'm passionate about writing clean, maintainable and scalable code. I enjoy learning new technologies, contributing to open source projects and solving complex problems with elegant solutions.
